payload.body: Native text scaling shipped. iOS: FrickTypography now applies roles via relative text styles (Font.system(_:design:weight:)) so they scale with Dynamic Type instead of the fixed Font.system(size:) generated tokens; FrickButton titles map to relative styles too; raw values kept as FrickTypography.Fixed.*, Generated/ untouched. Android: confirmed sp units already scale and nothing forces fontScale=1f; added regression coverage. Gate green: typecheck 0, swift 25/0, android 18 green. Documented in accessibility.md s6.
